blurb: Guests can book guided fly fishing trips year round in Rochester, NY targeting species like brown trout, steelhead, Atlantic salmon, and king salmon. Trips include half day and full day options with gear, snacks, and lunch included as stated. Fly fishing lessons and fly tying classes are also offered for all skill levels, from beginner to advanced.
